newsitem.title: USA: National Vision stake raised by group.
newsitem.headline: National Vision stake raised by group.

text.p: A group including WisdomTree Capital Management Inc said Wednesday it raised its stake in National Vision Associates Ltd to 6.9 percent or 1,413,170 common shares from a previous stake of 5.6 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 241,170 shares of the Georgia-based company between Dec. 31 and Jan. 31 at prices ranging from $3.93 to $4.98 per share.
Others named in the filing group were WisdomTree Associates LP and WisdomTree Offshore Ltd.
